audit.source_question:
A B \perp D C and G H \perp F E. If \triangle A C D \sim \triangle G E F, find A B.
Choices:
A:2.2
B:3.6
C:4.4
D:6.3
audit.independent_solution: Corresponding altitudes have the same similarity ratio as corresponding sides:AB/GH=AC/GE=4.4/6.3. Therefore AB=3.15·4.4/6.3=2.2, option A.
